patient_identity.statement: Family 2 II-1 corresponds to female39 at examination. All three affected individuals and relatives were compared.

evidence.locator: Table1 Family 2 II-1 column; Clinical manifestation paragraphs; Figure1a,b; SupplementFigureS1

genotype.statement: Biallelic CMPK2 c.1A>C/start-lost plus c.1241A>G/p.Y414C matches Table1, Figure1 and packet; Table1 uses GRCh38 and NM_207315.

evidence.locator: Table1 Family 2 II-1 column; Clinical manifestation paragraphs; Figure1a,b; SupplementFigureS1

segregation.statement: Figure1 shows paternal c.1A>C and maternal c.1241A>G. Co-segregation is reported for tested relatives only.

evidence.locator: Figure1a,b

phase.statement: Parental genotypes support the two variants in trans.

evidence.locator: Figure1a,b parental and offspring genotypes

causal_confidence.statement: Authors propose recessive CMPK2-associated brain calcification based on two families, cell localization and mouse KO/KI evidence. Table1 explicitly says ACMG classification was applied for convenience because formal rules concern established Mendelian genes.

evidence.locator: Results, Discussion and Table1 footnote

limitations: Source causal assertion, not independent clinical truth; Family1 also carries co-segregating LPIN1 p.P367R, deprioritized by authors using conservation and predictions; SupplementTableS1 M-CAP is damaging despite benign/tolerated other predictors.

phenotype_completeness.statement: Every selected/alternate phenotype, explicit negative and onset compared. Packet compresses CT extent, TCS, progression, laboratory detail and family context. II-3 neurological negatives are explicit despite radiographic disease.
